uniteDbPokemon.notes: Unite-DB public pokemon.json. v3 enumerates skills, boosted basic attacks, nested upgrade choices, Plus/enhanced effects, Unite Moves, and Unite Buffs.

sourceList.originalDescription: When HP is 30% or less; increase all damage dealt by 20%. When HP is low, increases all damage dealt.

Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, becoming a vine whip that strikes twice, pulls enemies between both vines, and stuns them for 0.4s, then applies a 20% slow for 1.5s. Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage. This boosted attack also pulls enemies inward between the vines.
Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage. This boosted attack also pulls enemies inward between the vines.
Venusaur hurls a large seed to the designated location, damaging all enemies in the radius. Hurl a large seed at the designated area, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect.

Venusaur hurls toxic sludge to the designated location, damaging, slowing movement speed by 50% for 2s (stacking with the radius slow), and poisoning all enemies in the radius when it lands. The sludge lingers; damaging enemies every 0.5s for 5s in the radius, slowing them by 50%, and reducing their Sp. Defense by 50% for 2s (refreshes every tick). Hurl unsanitary sludge to the designated area, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect, leaving them poisoned and decreasing their movement speed and Sp. Defense for a short time
Increased radius. Increased area of effect.

Venusaur emits a cone-shaped blast in the designated direction, damaging enemies and restoring health when it hits. Venusaur also takes 40% reduced damage for 2.5s. This move's healing is not increased by Venusaur's passive. Drain HP from enemies in the area of effect, dealing damage to them and restoring HP when this hits. Also reduces damage received for a short time.
Increased healing. Increases amount of HP restored.

Venusaur launches a barrage of sharp-edged leaves in the designated direction, damaging enemies 10 times over 0.75s. Launch many sharp-edged leaves in a quick succession of attacks, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect.

Venusaur charges for 0.7s before firing a beam of light in the designated direction, damaging enemies five times over 0.3s. Against Wild Pokémon: Each tick is capped at 450 damage and the total damage is capped at 2250. 2.5% Enemy Max HP Blast a bundled beam of light, dealing damage to enemies in a line.
Reduced cast time to 0.6s and base cooldown is reduced by 2s. Reduced cooldown.

Venusaur scatters petals around themself for 4.8s, increasing movement speed by 80% and damaging enemies every 0.3s in the radius (for a total of 16 damage ticks). This movement speed increase slowly decays during the duration of this move by 9% every 0.5s to a minimum of 17%. Petal Dance reduces the cooldown of Sludge Bomb or Giga Drain by 30% of the current remaining cooldown, per tick of damage that hit an enemy player (hitting multiple enemies reduces the cooldown more). Scatter petals around the user, increasing movement speed for a short time and dealing damage over time to enemies in the area of effect.
Increased radius. Increased area of effect.

Venusaur becomes unstoppable to hurl a massive seed to the designated location, damaging all enemies in the radius and slowing them by 35% for 1s. The seed then splits apart into 4 smaller seeds, each damaging all enemies in their radius. Launches a giant seed toward the designated area. The seed then splits apart, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and decreasing their movement speed for a short time.
Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield Buff duration: 6
